_comment: Splash's DFlash2 block drafter (`DFlash2DraftModel`, incoai's `-DFlash2` repos; Splash: ~/git/splash runtime/model/DFlashDraft.cpp). It ships as its own checkpoint with its own config, so it names its target config (`head_targets`). The drafter its target drafts with by default is the MLX conversion of Splash's own bundle (`published_as`: mlx-community/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash2-4bit, converted from incoai/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Splash's af4g64 draft images with no tensor requantized — Splash's weights exactly, which Splash quantizes from the bf16 checkpoint at load as `mlx.core.quantize` does, runtime/model/GgufPreparation.cpp). Its tensors sit at the checkpoint's top level (`fc.*`, `layers.N.*`, `candidate_selector.*`, hence the empty decoder prefix). It borrows its target's embedding and lm_head (Splash: `targetModel->addEmbedding`, `vocabularyProjection()`). It reads `target_taps` of its target's layers (`dflash_config.target_layer_ids`), side by side: `backbone_hidden_size` is their row width, `fc`'s input. Each of its projections' dynamic convolution weights are `draft_dynamic_size` wide: two stages, `conv_kernel_size` taps, one weight per `conv_group_size` channels (runtime/metal/abi/DraftAttention.h draft_dynamic_width). Its block is eight rows, the anchor and seven proposals (`spec_drafts`), all of which the target verifies (`spec_verify_rows`, a lane's: Splash's SPLASH_TARGET_VERIFY_ROWS).
